display.purpose: Page titles, the verdict, big figures.

band.purpose: Condensed caps titles in checklist card headers and the state strip.

label.purpose: Field labels and small print, never below 12px.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, dialogs and toasts only.

motion.name: tick-in
motion.purpose: Checklist rows arriving once when a result lands.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f4c430; color: #10161f; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font: 600 14px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f6cf55; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4c430; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Toggle
components.description: The chosen option in a toggle group; yellow stays for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-toggle button { height: 44px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #263345; background: #1f2a38; color: #e8edf3; font: 600 14px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-toggle .ds-on { background: #f2f5f9; color: #0e141c; border-color: #f2f5f9; }

components.name: Input
components.description: 44px text field with a yellow focus edge.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: #1a2431; color: #f2f5f9; border: 1px solid #2c3a4e; border-radius: 14px; font: 16px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9fadbf; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #f4c430; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,196,48,.3); }

components.name: State Strip
components.description: Signature: where the checklist landed, one segment lit.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); border: 1px solid #263345; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; background: #1a2431; } .ds-strip span { padding: 10px 0; text-align: center; font: 700 18px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(159,173,191,.6); } .ds-strip span + span { border-left: 1px solid #263345; } .ds-strip .ds-wait { background: #f4c430; color: #10161f; }

components.name: Checklist Card
components.description: Card with a condensed caps header band and ruled rows with marks in a figures column.
components.html:
Setup checklist

HTF structure2/2
Liquidity sweep1/2
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141c27; border: 1px solid #263345; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; color: #f2f5f9; font: 15px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-band { margin: 0; padding: 8px 16px; background: #1a2431; border-bottom: 1px solid #263345; font: 700 15px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid #263345; } .ds-row b { font: 700 24px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-row small { font-size: 16px; color: #9fadbf; } .ds-full { color: #4fd394; } .ds-part { color: #ff9f43; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Phone tab bar; yellow pill behind the active icon.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); background: #0e141c; border-top: 1px solid #263345; padding: 6px 4px 8px; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 600 12px Manrope, sans-serif; color: #9fadbf; } .ds-nav i { display: block; width: 48px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-nav .ds-active { color: #f2f5f9; } .ds-nav .ds-active i { background: #f4c430; }

narrative.overview: Every chart runs the preflight card before a trade is considered. Strict analysis, calm plain-spoken face. The look borrows type, palette, density and one signature move (the READY / WAIT / NO TRADE state strip) from aviation checklist cards; controls and navigation stay standard web.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled rows with a figures column

rules.name: One yellow
rules.body: Only the primary action, the active tab and the WAIT state are yellow.

rules.name: States are not decoration
rules.body: Green and red only mean a trade outcome or verdict.

dos: Keep one yellow element per screen
Say WAIT and NO TRADE plainly
donts: Green or red on anything that is not a trade outcome
